title: finding(fields): AvatarField writes a data: URL into an avatar field, a value a verified ADR-0104 deployment refuses (avatar is a file-reference type)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the contract review of PR objectui#10782 (objectui#7699), record `5856504060` (an out-of-scope producer). The seat read the site; the finding was not reproduced against a backend.

## The site

`packages/fields/src/widgets/AvatarField.tsx` on objectui `origin/main`:
- `:36` `onChange(reader.result as string)`
- `:38` `reader.readAsDataURL(file)`

The avatar widget reads the picked file into a `data:` URL and stores that string as the field VALUE. It never goes through `useUpload()` / `UploadProvider`, and it never mints a `sys_file` id.

## Why it matters

- `avatar` is a member of the file-reference family (`FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES`).
- The stored contract has been the bare `sys_file` id since `@objectstack/spec` `17.0.0` (`FileReferenceIdValueSchema`), and ADR-0104's 2026-09-05 addendum puts the physical column on that id.
- On a deployment whose `adr-0104-file-references` flag is recorded, or with `OS_DATA_VALUE_SHAPE_STRICT_ENABLED=1`, `validateRecord` refuses a non-id value with `invalid_type`. Every creation-attested datastore records that flag.
- A `data:` URL also inlines the whole image into the record row.

PR objectui#10782 retires the same class of client-side producer (the inline blob) for the file and image widgets. `AvatarField` is the remaining one it names.

## Direction (for triage to confirm or re-route)

Route the avatar pick through the ambient `UploadProvider`, the same way `FileField` / `ImageField` do after objectui#7699:
- submit the id through `fileValueForSubmit`, and refuse a pick with no id;
- keep reading legacy `data:` / URL values for display;
- the premise first: measure what a stock ObjectStack deployment does with the `data:` URL today (admitted warn-first, or refused).
